Hi Leo,

Thanks for asking about *Tidewrack III*. Ines made it in 2025 using oil and beeswax on linen. It measures 120 × 90 cm and was shown at Fold Gallery in March. The title evokes what the tide leaves behind.

The work is available at £4,000. There’s a faint scuff on the lower left edge of the frame, which I’d be happy to show you in a close-up.

Best,
Ines’s studio

Hi Leo,

Thanks for your interest in Ines’s *Tidewrack III* (2025). It’s an oil and beeswax painting on linen, measuring 120 × 90 cm. It was shown at Fold Gallery in March and is available for £4,000.

There’s a faint scuff on the lower-left edge of the frame. I’d be happy to send a close-up of the frame and some detail shots of the painted surface, or arrange a viewing if you’d like to see it in person.
